title: Memory, Retrieved Context, and Bias in Management Earnings Forecasts
authors: David S. Koo; Isabel Yanyan Wang; Shuting Wu
eligible_reason: Single common shock: aftercris = 1 if the management forecast is announced after June 2009 (SASCode_kww.sas lines 379-380), the same date for all firms/CEOs. The variation of interest is continuous or ordinal CEO recession-memory measures (RecCEO, RecLgthCEO, ceorecann, unempincdecile) interacted with aftercris, with every control also interacted with aftercris; after1-after5re are common calendar-window dummies. Appendix B uses entercris (common crisis-entry indicator). Not a staggered binary adoption design.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe: actmf (forecast bias) on aftercris x RecCEO and controls x aftercris, absorb(firmid ceoid year) or absorb(firmid ceoid), vce(cluster ceoid firmid); ppmlhdfe for forecast counts (numobs); Appendix B quarterly with absorb(ceoid YrQtr). Sample restricted to CEOs issuing forecasts both before and after the crisis.
data_files_note: Final regression datasets (kww_regdata1: 3,678 forecast observations, 50 variables) are shipped; raw commercial inputs (Compustat, CRSP, IBES, BoardEx, ExecuComp, Thomson) are not.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Design is a single-date post-crisis comparison with continuous memory intensity; not staggered.
